d: The great square of the city of Fera is finished by the façade of the real palace, with a large door, and above it a workable balcony. At the rise of the tent you can see the whole square enclosed by a thick People, confusedly arranged. Everyone has in their hand branches of olive woven ribbons, symbol of the supplications, and they show extreme affliction. To the right ara on which they burn perfumes: to the left Evandro, Ismene, and some of the most distinguished Citizens; then, on the balcony of the real palace, preceded by a sudden trumpet sound, a Banditor.
Alcest, Eumelo, Aspasia, Damigelle, and Cortigiani with Alceste, and sayings.
Temple of Apollos with colossal statue of the nume, ara, and tripod. Great priest preceded by ministers, and Sacrificers with incensemakers, and sacrificing instruments.

Alcest, Eumelo, Aspasia, Evandro, Ismene, Damigelle, Cortigiani, Popolo, and sayings. Enter the Queen's Following with gifts for the nume, and let the People with Priests take their place straight and left.
Alcest you are going to leave with Eumelo, and Aspasia; then Evandro, who hastens running, meets in her: then Ismene from somewhere else, and in haste.
Evandro, Ismene, and immediately to one, to two, to three, Ministers of the temple, Priests, Citizens, from different parts.
Dark, and thick forest sacred to the infernal gods, in the circuit of Fera, with crude simulacrics of the same. Night. Alceste, and Ismene.
Alcest, then choir of Numi infernali not seen, then the Numi themselves.

Inner room of the Admeto palace, with domestic shrine and ara, and marital bed. The scene is illuminated to celebrate the unexpected restoration of Admeto. Evandro, Cortigiani, Women, and Court Officers.
Alcest, and Damsel of Alcest, and Ismene.

Magnificent and uncovered vestibule, of the real palace, adorned with statues, and trophies. Among the spaces that leave the columns that support it you discover in different views the city. Day. Admeto, and Evandro.
Alceste, Ismene, Eumelo, Aspasia, followed by Donzelle with Alceste, and sayings: indi Numi infernali.
Evandro, Ismene, part of the Admeto courtiers, and of the Alcestian damsel: then several characters of those who left with Admeto, and with Eumelo, and Aspasia.
I follow after Cortigiani who surround him to disarm him; Eumelo, Aspasia, Damigelle d'Alceste, and sayings.
Apollo in bright cloud; Alceste closed in a group of clouds, and sayings.
